title: Mixed Event — The Sounds of a Summer Festival! — Episode4 Words from Long Ago

meta.Event: The Sounds of a Summer Festival!
meta.Event Outline: Akito and Toya are invited to perform at the Summer Festival's live concert as a substitute act. Back when Akito had lost sight of his goals after facing setbacks in soccer, he and Ena witnessed that very same event...

rows.Line: Shinonome Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Ugh, I'm so bored...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: (I have absolutely nothing to do. What did I usually do before?)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: (Soccer in the afternoon, watch soccer after I got home, practice juggling after dark and...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: (Wow, every day was really just all about soccer. But...)

rows.Speaker: Teammates
rows.Line: Musashino East is full of kids that left home and came all the way here to just play soccer, right?

rows.Speaker: Teammates
rows.Line: I heard that they practice forever after school too. It's like they're never not kicking around a ball.

rows.Speaker: Teammates
rows.Line: I mean, they're all serious about going pro, right? They're sacrificing all their free time just to achieve that goal.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: (I just didn't do enough. I didn't practice enough, I didn't prepare enough and everything else in between...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
(Someone's calling?
Ena...?)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Hello?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: <Akito, where are you right now?!>

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
Where? I'm at home...
Hang on, didn't you say you're going to the Summer Festival?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: <I did, and I'm calling you from the fairgrounds. I'm so glad you picked up. I'm in a little trouble at the moment.>

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
What you mean by trouble?
I'm not gonna be your errand boy if that's what this is about.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
<That's not why I'm calling you!
I got hurt, and I need you to come and get me!>

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: What...? You're hurt?
Summer Festival Fairgrounds

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Hey, Akito! I'm over here!!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
Geez, you really are hurt!
I brought your shoes but can you even walk right now?!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah!
My wooden sandal didn't fit right and really made my feet hurt. I'm so glad you were home...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
Wait, what...?!
You're not actually hurt?! I came all this way because your feet were sore?!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Don't call me for stuff like that! You know I rushed over because I was worried, right...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: What do you mean, Stuff like that? My feet really hurt, and I seriously can't walk, so I was legitimately in trouble!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Will you just shut up! Here, put on your shoes.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: I should be the one telling you to shut up! But thanks for bringing these...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Hey, wait! You brought my sneakers?! These are totally gonna clash with my yukata!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Seriously? You're worried about that?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Yes, it matters! Don't you know how dumb I'll look if I wear sneakers with this thing?!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: You were the one that said you needed something comfortable to walk in! Quit complaining!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
I know, but...!
I didn't mean these! It's gonna be so embarrassing if someone I know sees me wearing these...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
What?! Forget it, I'm leaving!
You're on your own!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: A-Akito, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: (Seriously, she just decides to go off on me after I came all this way to get her...?!)

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
Huh? Akito...?
I didn't know you were here!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: It's you...!

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
Long time no see!
I was wondering what you were up to after that tournament.

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: So are you really gonna quit playing soccer, Akito? Everybody's saying that they want you to come back...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: I promise to start practicing just as hard as you do! Please, come back so we can all...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
Like I said before, that's not the issue.
I'm done playing soccer.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Bye.

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: There's just no point...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: It doesn't matter how much I try...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: A-Akito...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
Ena...
You finally decide to put your shoes on?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: What choice did I have?! I won't be able to get home if I don't, but I look so stupid...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Relax, nobody's paying attention to what you're wearing.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: What?! That's not what I'm talking about!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, that other boy... Isn't he the one from your soccer team?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Why do you care?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
And I'm done playing soccer.
I'm not on that team anymore.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: But you've had this cloud over your head lately.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: What are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: You know exactly what I'm talking about. Right after you quit, you've been so mopey. It's honestly hard not to notice.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
Shut up!
What do you know about how I...?!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
What's going on?!
Where's this noise coming from...?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Oh, it's probably that concert. I saw a bunch of people moving towards that stage over there...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: A concert? Like Summer Fest?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
I dunno, but I think so.
Anyway, I'm not really interested, so I'm going home...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
Akito, wait!
Wanna try checking it out since we're here?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
Why?
Also, what about your foot...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
I'm in my sneakers now, so I'm fine!
C'mon, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, wait...!
Quit pulling my arm!!
Summer Festival Stage

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Whoa, everyone's really into it!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Is this artist really popular or something? The whole crowd's going nuts...!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, they are...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
(Live concerts, huh....?
I've never really been interested in music.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: (But... I think I like this.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: (Whoa, they're cheering even louder now...!!)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: (They're making everything shake like crazy...! I never knew that a musician could make so many people go wild like this...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: This is awesome...

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Summer Festival Fairgrounds

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
Alright, wanna head home?
That show was amazing...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
(That was so incredible.
My heart's still pounding...!)

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line: Man, that event was something else!

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line: Yeah! But this has nothing on KEN and his crew!

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line: They're just on a completely different level. Isn't he putting on a huge event or something next year?

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line:
Yeah, I heard that too!
I can't wait to see what happens!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
(KEN...?
There's someone better than who I just saw...?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
Akito? Hey, you there?
Did that concert really get to you?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: No! Quit asking!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
I totally get how you feel.
The music, the crowd, everything... It was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: I said quit asking!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, Akito...
Why don't you try doing something like that...?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: This was the first time in a while that I saw you actually having fun. Why not try taking a stab at this kind of music?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
Try...?
You expect me to just dive in without really knowing if I can even succeed?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
Who said anything about diving in?
Just have fun with it, you know?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: But... What if I end up quitting that too? I'd look really stupid for even trying in the first place.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: You need to stop giving up before you've even given it a chance, alright?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
Shut up...!
What do you know about me?!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: What do I know? Well, nothing. How am I supposed to know how you feel?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Even if I said that I do know how you feel, you'd just snap back by saying that I don't, right?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: You just need to quit obsessing over details. You're really athletic, so I'm sure there's a lot you're capable of, but you need to give things a try first.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: You can think about taking it up seriously later on.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: (Later on, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
Fine, if I feel like it...
I'll keep thinking about it...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
Now, let's go home.
Oh, wanna get some cheesecake at the convenience store on the way back? We can eat it when we get back.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Hmm... Okay...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: (I can decide later...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: (And I can start by just listening to a few songs...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And I'm doing this now because she told me to just give it a try back then.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (That concert taught me how incredible music is, then I saw RAD WEEKEND, and now I'm on this path...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I met Toya and even ended up forming Vivid BAD SQUAD...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (If I didn't have that conversation with Ena back then, where would I be now?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And I'm guessing she's forgotten all about it now...)
